newsitem.title: USA: Northfield Laboratories signs blood pact.
newsitem.headline: Northfield Laboratories signs blood pact.

text.p: Northfield Laboratories Inc said Wednesday it signed a three-year supply agreement with Hemerica Inc worth more than $6.4 million.

Hemerica will provide a total of more than 247,000 units of packed red blood cells that will allow Northfield to continue its blood substitute development programs, the company said. Most of the red blood cells delivered will most likely be too old for transfusion into humans, Northfield said.
Northfield said it also plans to build a commercial production facility with the capacity to produce 300,000 units of its blood substitute PolyHeme each year.
